issues.title: 2008 US/CA 2.3 Turbo severe-duty oil interval cannot be inferred from dashboard service prompt alone
issues.cause: The original manual prescribes interim 5,000-mile oil and filter changes for specified severe-use patterns, alongside service indicator normal reminders.
symptoms: service records show extended oil interval despite repeated short drives
maintenance or oil grade history is unknown
issues.diagnosis_summary: Compare dated mileage records, driving use, appropriate original factory oil grade and physical car condition; do not infer healthy bearings from a current clean dipstick.
issues.correction_summary: Create a conservative, vehicle-specific maintenance plan grounded in original service recommendation; actual lubricant product equivalence requires current approval evidence.
limits: Factory recommendation is not proof that 5,000-mile servicing guarantees a Toyota-level lifespan.
Applicable to 2008 US/CA manual conditions, not an all-years maximum or universal oil standard.
Existing internal sludge or bearing damage cannot be reversed by changing oil.

issues.title: B235R manual sump, engine identity and PCV catalogue revisions complicate preventative inspection
issues.cause: Factory describes a dedicated sump procedure for B235R with manual gearbox, while independent parts catalogue reports overlapping PCV numbering and engine-number-specific hoses.
symptoms: unknown engine serial or vehicle option history
seller suggests generic B235 sump removal or PCV kit interchange
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record installed engine stamping and transmission, preserve dedicated B235R manual service access, confirm PCV hardware by manufacturer EPC and physical dimensions before disassembly or ordering.
issues.correction_summary: Use factory year/engine/gearbox-specific repair procedures, not generic sump instructions or a vendor claim alone.
limits: A factory repair procedure does not establish that the vehicle needs invasive inspection.
No ECU calibration or unrelated engine retrofit endorsed.
Supplier references and kit bundles do not approve interchange.
